blocking_issues: The card is close but not ready to stage because one boundary fact adds an unsupported location/fate claim beyond the source bundle.
revision_instructions: Revise the Great Azure Ocean boundary to the supported in-world fact only, e.g. `BOUNDARY: Instructed that his body be cast into the Great Azure Ocean after death; his end is chosen and final.`

After that correction, keep the current structure: the card is within the 40-fact cap, uses allowed prefixes, has no source refs in card facts, and follows the merged Berard identity rather than importing a wrong split persona.
unsupported_claims: `BOUNDARY: Instructed that his body be cast into the Great Azure Ocean — his end is chosen and final; he does not remain on Marmola` overreaches. The source supports the funerary instruction to cast his body into the Great Azure Ocean, but does not support `he does not remain on Marmola`.
